headline: Athletic lost 3-1 at Levante, yet the market still favours them
summary: Athletic Club lost 3-1 at Levante on Wednesday and host Getafe at San Mamés on Sunday. The reason they stay favoured is chance creation: Athletic average 1.59 expected goals a game, Getafe only 0.69, and Nico Williams is back in the squad after injury. Across the market, margin removed, Athletic are 58.8% favourites. Getafe have had 6 days to prepare, and they won 1-0 at San Mamés on their last visit — but their attacking numbers say a repeat is a stretch. The market expects a low-scoring afternoon, a fair total of 2.14 goals.
read: Athletic Club are 58.8% favourites at San Mamés: they are unbeaten at home, create 1.59 xG a game, and have Nico Williams back in the squad, while Getafe average just 0.69 xG and have scored three goals in five. The one thing arguing the other way is the head-to-head — Getafe won 1-0 here last season — and the goal line has slipped to 2.14, pointing to a tight, low-scoring afternoon.

facts.fact: Athletic Club are 58.8% favourites to win at San Mamés — more than three times Getafe's chance.
facts.meaning: The market expects a home win and rates Athletic roughly a goal better, despite a run of three draws in five.

facts.fact: Athletic lost 3-1 away at Levante on 21 October, four days before this match.
facts.meaning: A short week after their heaviest defeat of the run; coach Terzić blamed two midfield giveaways for it, and Getafe will press exactly there.

facts.fact: Nico Williams has returned to group training and is back in Athletic's squad after injury.
facts.meaning: Athletic's main one-on-one wide threat is available again — exactly the kind of player who unpicks a deep, compact Getafe block.

facts.fact: Athletic average 1.59 xG per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are creating enough to win comfortably; the dropped points have come from finishing, not from a lack of chances.

facts.fact: Getafe average 0.69 xG per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: Scoring even once at San Mamés is a stretch on this chance creation, let alone twice.

facts.fact: The market's 50/50 goal line has slipped from 2.2 to 2.14 goals in recent days.
facts.meaning: A tight, low-scoring game is the base case — the market leans under 2.5 goals.

facts.fact: Getafe won 1-0 at San Mamés on their last visit, in October 2025.
facts.meaning: They have recent proof they can sit deep here, survive, and take the three points.

facts.fact: Oihan Sancet needs more time before returning and is doubtful for this match.
facts.meaning: Doubtful is not out, but Athletic may be missing another attacking option alongside the returning Nico Williams.

sources.fact: Nico Williams has returned to group training and is back in Athletic's squad after injury.
Athletic lost 3-1 away at Levante on October 21, their first defeat at the Ciutat de Valencia since 2018.
Athletic coach Terzić said his side must stop giving away silly balls in midfield, blaming two midfield losses for the Levante defeat.
Oihan Sancet needs more time before returning and his availability for the Getafe match is doubtful.
Athletic drew 0-0 away at Valencia in their previous La Liga match.
Before their rescheduled Levante match, Athletic sat 11th in La Liga with 9 points.
Ivan Azon has returned to full team training after recovering from discomfort, giving Getafe another attacking option for the Athletic match.
Dani Carvajal has joined Getafe after leaving Real Madrid and made his debut with a first start and an ovation from the home fans.
